description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Luxembourg Luxembourg 2026-2028 eleven annual statutory holidays with explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline before individualized leave result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when luxembourg 2026-2028 statutory holiday dates over an explicitly selected Monday-Friday planning baseline, BEFORE individual annual or compensatory leave. A holiday on a normally non-worked day may produce compensatory leave depending on the employee's schedule, hours and applicable rules; no compensation date or next-Monday closure is assigned here. Bank-only Good Friday/Christmas Eve afternoon, customary or collectively agreed holidays, school/local/employer/shift schedules, hours, payroll, personal entitlements and legal deadlines are not computed.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2028 authority events. Requires explicit mon_fri_planning; personal compensatory leave and bank-only closures are not computed.
Example user requests: Luxembourg: Europe Day is statutory rest. | Luxembourg: No uniform Monday compensation date. | Luxembourg: Bank-only Good Friday is not general statutory rest.
Inputs: date (date); work_schedule (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-05-09","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"} | {"date":"2026-05-11","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"} | {"date":"2026-04-03","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources, work_schedule, is_statutory_non_working_day, holiday_on_baseline_weekend, compensatory_leave_scope, compensatory_date_policy, personal_roster_scope, payroll_scope.
Formula: planning_workday = weekday AND no statutory_holiday_rest; individual leave is not deducted
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/luxembourg-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/luxembourg-public-working-day.md
